svg.title: Wealth Coach AI. Turn every paycheck into a personalized wealth plan. An AI powered personal finance coach for everyday Indians earning ₹20,000 to ₹5,00,000 a month: it reads your salary, expenses, age, goal and risk appetite, then recommends where to invest, why it fits, and how consistent investing compounds. It answers one question: given my income, where should I invest my money this month? Chart: with the app's default profile (₹50,000 salary, ₹30,000 expenses, medium risk) the planner suggests ₹16,000 a month; at the 12% a year the app assumes, that projects to about ₹36.8 lakh after 10 years (₹2.0L at year 1, ₹6.9L at year 3, ₹13.1L at year 5). A live demo runs on Streamlit Cloud.

div.div: Wealth Coach AI · personal finance coach
div.p: Tells first time investors where this month's money should go, and why.
For everyday Indians earning ₹20,000 to ₹5,00,000 a month. Enter salary, expenses, age, goal and risk appetite; get a plan, ranked opportunities and a growth path.
"Given my income, where should I invest my money this month?"
Projection math from the app's wealth journey chart. Illustrative, not a promise of returns.
